# freepasswordgenerator.app

## Summary
freepasswordgenerator.app is a free, browser-based password generator that creates strong, cryptographically secure passwords instantly with no login, no cloud storage, and no tracking.

## Key Facts
- 100% client-side — passwords never leave the browser
- Uses crypto.getRandomValues() for cryptographic randomness
- Supports random passwords (4–128 characters) and passphrases (3–10 words)
- Generates up to 20 passwords at once
- Password strength meter with entropy and crack time estimates
- No login, no account, no analytics, no cookies
- Dark mode support
- Mobile responsive
- Bulk generate and download 50/100 passwords as .txt

## Features
- Adjustable password length and character types
- Custom symbol sets
- Exclude ambiguous characters (0, O, l, 1, I)
- Passphrase mode with 2048-word dictionary
- One-click copy and copy-all
- Session-only password history (cleared on tab close)
- Keyboard shortcuts for power users
